# Cleura - AS42695

## News

October 2026: AS42695 (Cleura) will slowly be absorbed by AS57829 (Iver).  
November 2025: We have set up a new looking-glass at [lg.cleura.net](https://lg.cleura.net).  
During testing, the legacy one will remain  available at [legacy-lg.as42695.net](http://legacy-lg.as42695.net).  

## IXPs

We support BFD on our IXPs, and will opportunistically try to establish BFD session with you if bfd_support is set to True in the database.

## Peerings

We have a generally open [peering policy](http://as42695.net/peering-policy.txt), but will not peer with transit customers or their customers.

## Tools

* We are actively participating in the [NLNOG Ring](https://ring.nlnog.net/participants/) project.  
If you are also a participant, you can use our nodes for troubleshooting.
* Our [RIPE Atlas probes](https://atlas.ripe.net/probes/public?is_public=true&toggle=public&status=1&search=AS42695) might also be helpful for the same purpose.
* Feel free to use our [looking glass](http://lg.as42695.net) too.
